responsibility: Implements loop unswitching for tree SSA, cloning loops to hoist invariant conditions out of the loop body. It discovers invariant gcond and switch-edge predicates, tracks predicate paths and range information to simplify cloned CFGs, applies profitability limits to avoid code growth, updates profile and PHI handling when guards are hoisted or loops are duplicated, and repeatedly unswitches innermost loops until no worthwhile invariant branch remains.
